entities.summary: I am a Senior Data Analyst at Bridgemark, effective this pay period, with an annual salary of $74,500. I took over the MedVantage quarterly reporting deliverable around March 3rd, which contributed to my promotion. I attended a team offsite near Mount Hood last week, where my colleague Raj Patel presented a dashboard prototype to upper management. I prefer smaller breakout sessions over large group activities. I no longer have a freelance visualization gig, which ended in February. I am currently focused on Bridgemark and the MedVantage work, with a long-term interest in data engineering.

entities.name: user
entities.summary: User started at Bridgemark Solutions on January 15th this year as a Junior Data Analyst. Bridgemark Solutions is a mid-size consulting firm with about 200 employees, located on SW 5th Avenue in downtown Portland. User's manager is Diane Kowalski, who leads the analytics team and has been with the company for seven years. In late February, User was moved from the general analytics pool to a dedicated client project for MedVantage, a healthcare company. User's title was updated in February to Data Analyst following a restructuring that removed junior and senior labels from the team.
